text:
name: rag_knowledge_produce_fix
question: >-
  Fix the producer-side pointer contract so the async knowledge spine actually populates. Today
  kb_produce.py emits KnowledgeEvents whose content_hash = sha256(card.text) while source_uri points
  at the whole _results_summary.json, so the consumer's read_artifact + verify_content_hash always
  fail, every event retries, and nothing lands in the stores. Also add structured confidence /
  perturbation_strength to KnowledgeRecord (they are currently dropped to prose), then clear the
  stuck stream, re-emit, drain, and verify the stores actually populate.
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true
    context:
      brief: >-
        The producer code is well-tested but its event contract is broken at the producer->consumer
        boundary, and the unit tests enshrine the bug (test_content_hash_recomputes_from_text asserts
        content_hash == sha256(text), which is exactly the contract viola…
